data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'khriseas', meaning 'crystalline, clear, pure'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes the purity and clarity of faith. The name Chrystel carries the meaning “Pure, Crystal Clear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Chrystel usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, crystal clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
